newsitem.title: INDIA: India silver prices fall as imported metals arrive.
newsitem.headline: India silver prices fall as imported metals arrive.

text.p: Indian silver prices fell on Wednesday in the wake off overnight world market losses and imported silver arrivals, dealers said.
About 1,000/1,200 kg of the imported silver arrived on Wednesday in the Bombay market. Sentiment was subdued at the close of the session amid scattered physical enquiries.
Gold prices opened lower following weak overseas trends and remained unchanged on scattered arrivals towards the close.
Physical buying however remained low but traders were expecting higher seasonal buying in the next few days for gold. Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) fell by 100 rupees at 56,800 rupees.
